findings.title: Managed Compute — all compute on raw EC2
findings.description: All compute runs on raw EC2 instances with Mongrel clusters behind Apache mod_proxy_balancer. No managed container orchestration or serverless.
findings.gap: No managed compute services. All operational burden (patching, scaling, capacity planning) is manual.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to ECS on Fargate after containerizing. Prerequisite: Ruby/Rails version upgrade and Dockerfile creation.

findings.title: Managed Databases — self-managed MySQL on EC2
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 self-managed on a separate EC2 instance. No managed database services found.
findings.gap: All databases self-managed on EC2. Manual patching, backup, and failover.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for MySQL 8.0 or Aurora MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — no orchestration for order/payment flow
findings.description: Order creation flow (save → charge payment) is inline sequential code with no orchestration, retry logic, or compensating actions.
findings.gap: No orchestration — order+payment workflow hardcoded with no retry or error handling.
findings.recommendation: Implement Step Functions for the order→payment workflow after modernizing the stack.

findings.title: Async Messaging — no messaging infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. Payment gateway call is synchronous, blocking the HTTP request thread.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries — tight synchronous coupling to external payment gateway.
findings.recommendation: Introduce SQS for payment processing decoupling: accept order synchronously, enqueue payment job, process async.

findings.title: Network Security — no VPC or security group configuration
findings.description: No VPC, subnet, security group, or network segmentation configuration found. No HTTPS termination.
findings.gap: No evidence of network security controls. Services may be in default VPC with no isolation.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in custom VPC with private subnets. Configure least-privilege security groups. Add ALB for HTTPS.

findings.title: API Entry Point — no managed entry point
findings.description: No managed API entry point. Apache mod_proxy_balancer on EC2 provides no throttling, auth, or TLS termination.
findings.gap: Services exposed through self-managed Apache proxy with no modern gateway capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Deploy ALB with HTTPS listeners. Consider API Gateway as architecture matures.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — no auto-scaling configured
findings.description: No auto-scaling. Deployment to a fixed set of EC2 hosts — all capacity statically provisioned.
findings.gap: No auto-scaling — cannot respond to traffic spikes or scale down during low demand.
findings.recommendation: After containerizing on ECS/Fargate, configure auto-scaling with target tracking.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. MySQL 5.1 on EC2 has no automated backup, no PITR, no retention policy.
findings.gap: No backup configuration. Data loss event would be unrecoverable.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with automated backups (7+ day retention) and PITR enabled.

findings.title: High Availability — no multi-AZ configuration
findings.description: No multi-AZ configuration found. Fixed EC2 hosts likely in single AZ. MySQL on separate EC2 with no replication.
findings.gap: All resources likely in a single AZ. AZ failure takes down entire workload.
findings.recommendation: Enable Multi-AZ on RDS. Deploy ECS services across 2+ AZs with ALB cross-zone load balancing.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code — zero IaC coverage
findings.description: Zero IaC coverage. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or any IaC files. All infrastructure manually created.
findings.gap: No IaC — all infrastructure created manually. Non-reproducible, non-auditable.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in Terraform or CDK. Start with database, networking, and compute.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no pipelines
findings.description: No CI/CD pipelines. No GitHub Actions, Jenkinsfile, or buildspec.yml. Deployment is manual via Capistrano 2.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments are manual with no automated testing or builds.
findings.recommendation: Implement GitHub Actions or CodePipeline with lint → test → build → deploy stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages — Ruby 1.8.7 / Rails 2.3 (both EOL)
findings.description: Ruby 1.8.7 (EOL 2013) with Rails 2.3 (EOL). Compound legacy: language, framework, and SDK all deeply regressed. Cannot run modern AWS SDK.
findings.gap: Language version, framework, and SDK all regressed. Ruby has limited cloud-native tooling depth.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Ruby 3.2+ and Rails 7.x. Consider rewrite in a language with deeper cloud-native tooling.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices — tightly-coupled monolith
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith with SQL in controllers, payment logic mixed with business logic, no module boundaries.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no clear module boundaries, pervasive shared state.
findings.recommendation: First strengthen internal module boundaries, then apply Strangler Fig pattern. See Decomposition Strategy.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication — all synchronous
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. Payment gateway SOAP call blocks the request thread. Archetype: stateful-crud — sync-only across service boundary is a gap.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns. Payment blocks user-facing request.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async processing for payment via SQS. Return order as pending with polling.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — all synchronous regardless of duration
findings.description: Payment gateway SOAP call could exceed 30 seconds. No timeout, no async processing, no status polling. Archetype: stateful-crud — gap.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. Payment blocks HTTP response with no timeout.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for payment operations with status polling endpoint.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy — no versioning
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. No /v1/ URL patterns, no version headers.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-path versioning (e.g., /api/v1/orders) when rebuilding the API layer.

findings.title: Service Discovery — hard-coded endpoints
findings.description: Service endpoints hard-coded in config/payment.yml. No service registry or dynamic discovery.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded in configuration files.
findings.recommendation: Use environment variables as immediate improvement; adopt AWS Service Discovery as architecture evolves.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage — assets on local filesystem
findings.description: Static assets served from the application's local filesystem on EC2. No S3, no CDN.
findings.gap: Data on local file systems with no managed storage.
findings.recommendation: Migrate static assets to Amazon S3. Add CloudFront as CDN.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer — raw SQL in controllers
findings.description: Direct SQL queries with string interpolation in controller. No repository pattern, no data access layer.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered in controllers with no pattern. Raw SQL bypasses ORM.
findings.recommendation: After Rails upgrade, use ActiveRecord scopes exclusively. Extract repository/service layer.

findings.title: Database Engine Version — MySQL 5.1 long past EOL
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 reached end-of-life December 2013. Over 12 years without security patches.
findings.gap: Database engine at EOL with known unpatched CVEs. No version management.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to MySQL 8.0 on RDS or Aurora MySQL immediately.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — no encryption configured
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 on EC2 with no encryption at rest. Customer order data including card numbers stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for any data store.
findings.recommendation: Enable EBS encryption immediately. Target: RDS with KMS encryption.

findings.title: API Authentication — no authentication
findings.description: No API authentication. Controller notes 'No before_filter auth on some actions (legacy oversight).' Endpoints are open.
findings.gap: No API authentication — endpoints are open.
findings.recommendation: Implement authentication immediately. Target: OAuth2/JWT with Cognito.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration — no identity provider
findings.description: No identity provider integration. No Cognito, no OIDC, no SAML. No authentication exists at all.
findings.gap: Application has no authentication — no external IdP integration possible.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito as centralized IdP after implementing auth.

findings.title: Secrets Management — plaintext credentials in source control
findings.description: Plaintext payment credentials (merchant_id, api_password) in config/payment.yml checked into source control. Session secret also in source.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source control — critical security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: IMMEDIATE: rotate credentials. Move to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Scrub git history.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching — no patching strategy
findings.description: No patching strategy. All runtime components (Ruby 1.8.7, Rails 2.3, Mongrel, MySQL 5.1) are EOL with known CVEs.
findings.gap: No evidence of patching. All components EOL with known CVEs.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade all components to supported versions. Implement SSM Patch Manager. Enable Inspector.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No SAST, no DAST, no dependency scanning. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate into.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools configured. Vulnerabilities reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: When implementing CI/CD, include Dependabot, Semgrep for SAST, and ECR image scanning.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — no tracing instrumented
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing — debugging requires manual log correlation.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with X-Ray or OpenTelemetry after modernizing the stack.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — no SLOs defined
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No CloudWatch alarms on latency or error rate. No monitoring infrastructure.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for order creation latency, error rate, and availability.

findings.title: Business Metrics — no custom metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No business dashboards, no order volume tracking.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — no visibility into business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish business metrics: orders/minute, payment success rate, order value distribution.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — no alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection.
findings.gap: No alerting — failures discovered by users, not monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates, latency, and payment failures.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — direct-to-production via Capistrano
findings.description: Direct-to-production deployment via Capistrano 2 to all hosts simultaneously. No staged rollout.
findings.gap: Direct-to-production with no staged rollout. Bad deploy affects all users immediately.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployments via CodeDeploy after containerizing on ECS.

findings.title: Integration Testing — no working tests
findings.description: No working tests. README notes tests are stale and no longer run. No test files present.
findings.gap: No automated tests — no safety net for changes or refactoring.
findings.recommendation: Establish integration test suite covering order creation, payment, and retrieval.

findings.title: Incident Response Automation — no runbooks
findings.description: No runbooks, no automated incident response, no self-healing automation.
findings.gap: No runbooks — incident response is entirely ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create structured runbooks for common incidents as SSM Automation documents.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no ownership defined
findings.description: No observability ownership. No CODEOWNERS for monitoring, no per-service dashboards, no named owners.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Define CODEOWNERS for monitoring. Create per-service dashboards with team attribution.

findings.title: Resource Tagging Governance — no tags
findings.description: No resource tagging. No IaC where tags would be defined. No tagging standard.
findings.gap: No tags on resources. Cannot track costs or identify ownership.
findings.recommendation: Define tagging standard (Environment, Service, Team, CostCenter) when implementing IaC.
